stories.title: TSMC employee data breach linked to cloud provider
stories.summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) confirmed that personal employee data has been leaked online after a threat actor put 6.9GB of information allegedly stolen from the company up for auction.

stories.title: Telegram Widgets Hit by RCE Demos, Malware Warning Days After Launch
stories.summary: Kaspersky suspects exploitation of Telegram’s new widgets to deliver WebRAT, as researchers demo RCE and Pavel Durov disputes the claims.

stories.title: Scans for LiteLLM/Starlette (CVE-2026-42271, CVE-2026-48710), (Mon, Nov 16th)
stories.summary: This weekend, we started seeing requests for /mcp-rest/test/tools/list hitting our honeypots. These requests appear to attempt to exploit CVE-2026-42271 and CVE-2026-48710. Horizon3.ai published a short write-up about how these vulnerabilities can be chained to achieve remote code execution without authentication [Horizon3]

stories.title: Microsoft Rules Out Cyberattack in Outage, Warns of Phishing Campaign
stories.summary: Phishing emails posing as Microsoft 365 service notices referenced the real outage incident and threatened to delete held messages.

stories.title: Cursor Says Stolen Fireworks AI Key Led to Trojanized Claude Code Extension Incident
stories.summary: The compromise of Anthropic's official Claude Code extension on Cursor's extension marketplace was the result of the theft of an access key that was exposed in the wake of a breach targeting Fireworks AI. stories.title: Amazon Uncovers AI Agent Campaign Targeting LiteLLM, Dify, and Other Apps for API Keys
stories.summary: Attackers' AI agents have been hunting for weak spots in internet-exposed AI apps such as LiteLLM, One API, and Dify to steal the AI provider keys stored inside, according to the agents' own records. stories.title: BO Team Exploits Log4Shell in VMware vCenter, Compromises Russian Firm's Code-Signing Server
stories.summary: An investigation into suspicious activity within a Russian software developer's network has uncovered a months-long compromise of its development infrastructure and a software code-signing server. stories.title: Uber Data Breach Impacts 150,000 People
stories.summary: Hackers compromised a third-party services provider and stole names, addresses, and driver’s license numbers.

Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
